newsitem.title: UK: M & W says not in takeover discussions.
newsitem.headline: M & W says not in takeover discussions.

text.p: UK convenience store operator M & W said on Monday that it was not in takeover discussions with Portsmouth & Sunderland Newspapers Plc.
The company was responding to an article in the Mail on Sunday newspaper which said the printer and publisher was preparing a takeover bid for M & W.

Shares in M & W had jumped 28 pence to a high of 179-1/2 pence on the article which said Portsmouth would bid 32 million stg or 190 pence a share for M & W. The share price had slipped back to 157-1/2 pence by 0905 GMT.
M & W operates 176 convenience stores, while Portsmouth has been expanding its retailing activities through its 132 One Stop local grocery stores, mainly in the South of England.
